mentions.name: Article-to-podcast pipeline
mentions.description: This tool lets the user drop links to articles into a web UI built with Claude, which uses Haiku to clean the article text into a transcript and generates audio locally with Kokoro TTS. The resulting audio is published via RSS for listening in Apple Podcasts, providing personally curated audio for car commutes.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I drop links to articles in a WebUI Claude built and it uses Haiku to clean it up a bit to a transcript then Kokoro TTS locally to make audio.

I consume the same way. RSS in Apple Podcasts. Such a great way to spend time in the car since it’s so personally curated.
